title: Providing World-Class Intelligent Equipment for Top Global Enterprises
contentHtml:
TXAM announces the full completion and operation of its two smart manufacturing bases in Shenzhen and Huizhou, marking a new phase of scaled development for the company.

Dual-Base Structure Formed

With the successful topping-out of TXAM's 60,000㎡ smart manufacturing base in Huizhou, TXAM has established a "dual-core" layout with the Shenzhen headquarters as the core and Huizhou for capacity expansion. This structure will provide strong production and delivery guarantees for the company to undertake billion-yuan orders from world-class enterprises.

The Huizhou base adopts industry-leading smart production line designs, equipped with complete assembly, testing, and packaging systems, achieving full-process autonomous control from part processing to final delivery.

Digital Management Upgrade

While increasing capacity, TXAM continues to advance its digital transformation. By deploying advanced MES (Manufacturing Execution System) and WMS (Warehouse Management System), TXAM has achieved real-time collection, monitoring, and analysis of production data, greatly improving production efficiency and product quality stability.

The company stated that it will continue to increase R&D investment, deepen its focus on non-standard automation, and contribute more to China's smart manufacturing.
